scope: Pure Domain CPU optimization, source snapshots and full public-field model equality on .NET and bundled standalone Unity Mono. Parent owns integration, source compilation, native Unity tests and real ContinueResponsive measurements.
recommendedAmount: Keep the existing productive Amount.cs unchanged. Optional exact Math.Pow table was measured but contributes only approximately 1-2% on Mono after the transport changes.
behavior: Offline worker-owned model prepares worker/building/route plans once and checks cancellation/reporting after at most 128 ticks. Internal 32-second numerical groups preserve the actual previous ContinueResponsive remainder and per-tick UTC truncation exactly.
Delivery worker reference counts preserve busy-worker behavior including repeated worker references.
Reservation indexes preserve the original global delivery list order within each source/recipient/resource subsequence. No Amount sums are incrementally reassociated.
Pickup capacity reuses exact precomputed curve values and preserves multiplication/division/effect order.
Public Advance prepares for every positive-tick call as the original did and clears the plan on return. Offline retains a plan only inside its exclusive call.

fixtureScope.standard: Synthetic pure Domain established city model matching the prior native model benchmark shape: 112 level-500 buildings, 118 assigned workers, two cities, buffers and partial construction, remainder 0.375, warmup one tick. The historical standard model uses all enum worker attributes, so it is not a whole SaveValidator-approved persistence fixture.
fixtureScope.inventory10000: Same pure Domain shape with assigned-worker attributes restricted to their roles and 10,000 additional unassigned workers (slot -1, no building, unique id, role-allowed five attributes, rarity 4/rank 2/level 4). The added workers have valid shapes. No claim that the entire synthetic graph was passed through SaveValidator.
fixtureScope.regression: GameState.Create with productive definitions, role-allowed attributes, five remainder boundaries, construction and membership transitions; private cancellation and cleanup contracts.

canonicalRoundingCorrection.scope: 513-second full field graph comparison; only tickRemainder differed in the reported model. The final offline implementation intentionally reproduces the old actual UI 32-second groups. Parent synchronizes the convenience ApplyOffline() method to the shared constant; explicit caller-specified iterator groups retain their existing semantics.
